title: Ishida, Lorenzo / Independent Fixer Profile
summary: Profile of Lorenzo Ishida and his documented association with the independent group known as Last Call.
body:
SUBJECT

ISHIDA, LORENZO

Independent fixer operating within the Free-Void. Current area of influence centred on Vulcan III.

Ishida maintains a network of intermediaries rather than a conventional organisation. His actual number of active contacts is unknown.

OCCUPATION

Ishida facilitates transactions that conventional institutions are unwilling or unable to perform. Known activities include contract brokerage, information brokerage, asset recovery, personnel acquisition, discreet transportation, criminal mediation and debt collection.

Ishida rarely performs field work personally. His principal asset is access.

PERSONALITY ASSESSMENT

Ishida is patient. He prefers to know what another person wants before determining what he wants from them.

He is generally polite. This should not be interpreted as friendliness.

Ishida appears to regard emotional restraint as an operational advantage and rarely allows irritation to become visible during negotiations.

He is considerably more protective of his reputation than his finances.

LAST CALL

Ishida's association with Last Call began as a conventional contract arrangement. The relationship has since become unusual.

The group has completed several tasks for Ishida under circumstances where a more conventional contractor would have been preferred. Ishida has nevertheless continued to use them.

When questioned regarding the group's reliability, Ishida reportedly responded:

They finish things.

When questioned regarding their discretion:

No.

When asked why he continues to employ them:

Because those are different questions.

SOURCE STATUS

Ishida is an indirect source to Brightside. He is not affiliated with Brightside and is not believed to be aware of Brightside observation.

Statements attributed to Ishida are retained only where independently corroborated or where their provenance is considered operationally useful.

FINAL ASSESSMENT

Ishida is not considered a major political actor. He does not possess sufficient territory, manpower or institutional authority. His influence is instead distributed across individuals who require his services.

This makes his network difficult to measure.

Recommendation: Continue passive observation. Do not inform Ishida of Brightside interest.
